decisions.reason: As a visibly promoted multi-item line with its own page in both 2023 and 2024 and close fit to the firm's core natural facial-care business, it carries enough sunk cost and public commitment that management would be inclined to continue it.

The serum remains on the website across two years and fits the established skincare range, so even with less visible commitment than Product A the firm is likely to justify and maintain the launch rather than reverse it.

Although newer and less strongly committed than A or B, the cleansing oil is still closely related to the core offer and its short market history lets management explain any weaker traction as temporary, making retention more likely than withdrawal.
